metadata.name: PSScript
metadata.title: PSScript
metadata.description: Scaffolds a new PowerShell script or Azure Automation runbook, along with a README.md file.
metadata.author: Wouter van den Meulenhof

parameters.name: ScriptName
parameters.prompt: Enter the desired name of the script without the .ps1 extension. E.g., Verb-Noun, conforming to the PowerShell naming conventions.

parameters.name: ScriptSynopsis
parameters.prompt: Enter a brief synopsis of the script's functionality.

parameters.name: AuthorName
parameters.prompt: Enter the author's name. E.g. FirstName LastName.

parameters.name: AuthorEmail
parameters.prompt: Enter the author's email address. E.g. user@example.nl.

parameters.name: Date
parameters.prompt: Enter the date in Dutch format. E.g. DD-MM-YYYY.

parameters.name: Version
parameters.prompt: Enter the version of the script. Please follow semantic versioning (e.g., 1.0.0).
